terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.intro: These terms govern Profipaws (website and related apps). By creating an account, paying for access, or using the demo, you agree to this document.

sections.title: 1. What Profipaws is
paragraphs: Profipaws is a digital service to organise pet health records: vaccines, weight, calendar, documents, and temporary access for vets or family.
Profipaws does not replace veterinary care and does not provide medical diagnoses. You (or people you authorise) enter the information; always check with a professional when needed.

sections.title: 2. Account and access
paragraphs: Full access is unlocked with a one-time payment. You may also try a temporary demo with sample data; the demo is not a personal account and may reset.
Sign-in usually uses Google. You are responsible for your Google account security and for activity in Profipaws under that account.
You must provide accurate information and have legal capacity to contract (or consent from a legal guardian where required).

sections.title: 3. Demo
paragraphs: The demo is only for trying the product. Sample data may be wiped or reset at any time. Do not store real pet records in the demo.

sections.title: 4. Payments
paragraphs: The full-access price is shown before checkout. Payments are processed by Stripe. After a valid payment, we activate access on your account.
Except as stated in the refund policy, digital access is considered delivered once activated.

sections.title: 5. Acceptable use
paragraphs: You may not use Profipaws for illegal or abusive activity, to infringe others’ rights, or to access other users’ data without authorisation.
You must not interfere with security, availability, or integrity of the service.

sections.title: 6. Content and pet data
paragraphs: You keep ownership of content you upload. You grant us a limited licence to host and process it solely to provide the service.
If you share a pet or create temporary vet access, you are responsible for who receives it and for revoking it when appropriate.

sections.title: 7. Availability and changes
paragraphs: We aim for a reliable service, but downtime can occur. We may improve or change features and will communicate material changes when appropriate.

sections.title: 8. Liability
paragraphs: To the extent allowed by law, Profipaws is not liable for indirect damages, lost profits, or decisions based solely on information stored in the app.
Nothing here limits mandatory consumer rights where they apply.

sections.title: 9. Termination
paragraphs: You may stop using the service and request account deletion. We may suspend or close accounts that breach these terms or endanger the service or other users.

sections.title: 10. Governing law
paragraphs: Unless mandatory law says otherwise, these terms are interpreted under Spanish and applicable EU rules for consumers and digital services.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data Profipaws processes, why, with whom, and your rights. The controller is the Profipaws service operator (contact below).

sections.title: 1. Data we process
paragraphs: Account data: email, name, Google ID, and profile photo if Google provides it.
Pet and animal-health data you enter (history, vaccines, weight, files, calendar, notes).
Technical session data: access tokens, language/theme preferences, basic security and service logs.
Payment data: handled by Stripe; we receive payment status and references needed to unlock access, not your full card number.

sections.title: 2. Purposes and legal bases
paragraphs: Provide the service and maintain your account (contract).
Process the one-time payment and prevent fraud (contract and legitimate interest / legal obligation where applicable).
Send calendar reminder emails when that feature is enabled (contract / legitimate interest).
Comply with legal obligations and respond to authorities when required.

sections.title: 3. Processors and third parties
paragraphs: Google (sign-in).
Stripe (payments).
Hosting providers (such as Railway and Vercel) and, if configured, the email provider for reminders.
They process data under their terms and only as needed for the service.

sections.title: 4. Retention
paragraphs: We keep data while your account exists or as needed for the service, claims, or legal duties. Demo data may reset automatically.
You can request account deletion in the app; we delete or anonymise related personal data except where law requires retention.

sections.title: 5. Your rights
paragraphs: You may request access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection, and portability where applicable, and lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority.
To exercise rights, email the contact address on this page.

sections.title: 6. Children
paragraphs: Profipaws is not directed at children under 16 without parental consent where required. We may delete accounts that appear to breach this rule.

sections.title: 7. Security and transfers
paragraphs: We apply reasonable security measures (encryption in transit, access controls). No system is perfectly secure.
International transfers via cloud providers use safeguards required by applicable law where relevant.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.intro: This policy describes cookies and similar technologies used by Profipaws.

sections.title: 1. What we use
paragraphs: Cookies or storage needed for authentication and session security.
On-device preferences: language and theme.
We do not set advertising cookies or marketing analytics cookies for ads.

sections.title: 2. Why they are necessary
paragraphs: Without these technical technologies we could not sign you in, remember language/theme, or protect your session. They are essential to the service.

sections.title: 3. Third parties
paragraphs: Google sign-in and Stripe checkout may set their own cookies under their policies. Please review those on their official sites.

sections.title: 4. How to manage them
paragraphs: You can clear site data in your browser settings. Removing local storage or session cookies will require signing in again.

notice.title: Legal notice
notice.intro: General information about the operator and use of the Profipaws website and services.

sections.title: 1. Identification
paragraphs: Service operator: Profipaws.
Website: https://profipaws.vercel.app
Contact: hola@profipaws.com
If you need further identifying details for a formal claim, email us and we will provide the available controller information.

sections.title: 2. Purpose
paragraphs: The site describes Profipaws and provides access to the app, demo, and full-access checkout.

sections.title: 3. Intellectual property
paragraphs: Profipaws brand, design, text, and software are protected. You may not copy or exploit them without permission, except as allowed by law.

sections.title: 4. Content responsibility
paragraphs: We aim for accurate information, but errors may occur. Each pet’s clinical history depends on what users record.

sections.title: 5. Links
paragraphs: We may link to third parties (Google, Stripe, etc.). Their sites and practices are outside our control.

refunds.title: Refund policy
refunds.intro: Profipaws sells one-time digital access. This policy explains when a refund may be requested.

sections.title: 1. General rule
paragraphs: Once full access is activated on your account, the digital service is considered delivered. Refunds are therefore not automatic.

sections.title: 2. Cases we will help with
paragraphs: Duplicate charge or a technical error that prevents activation after a valid payment.
Severe ongoing inability to use the service caused by Profipaws, if we cannot fix it within a reasonable time.

sections.title: 3. How to request
paragraphs: Email hola@profipaws.com from your account address with payment date, Google email used, and a short description of the issue.
We will review and reply. If a refund is approved, it is processed via Stripe to the original payment method when possible.

sections.title: 4. Demo
paragraphs: The demo is free and does not create a charge or refund right.

sections.title: 5. Consumer rights
paragraphs: If consumer law gives you a mandatory withdrawal or warranty right, that right prevails over this policy where it applies.
